content: Tamba ngwuk kat wawa nyaangɨt nat samat ngambuvat wowun. Kɨta nyana mat nyan ngɨni ndɨna nyaekna wowun. Kɨta nyana mat nyan ngɨni ndɨna nyaekna kwanda kwanda klalaa vɨga lɨgiyandɨ. Mbambala mat nyana. Ana vɨga lɨgandɨ. Ndi kwo nyan vla lɨgandɨ.
Mat nyan tɨga yetɨnda vak ndɨna nyaek waa nɨmba nat nɨmba vɨga lɨndi ndɨ kat. Dɨna nyaek waa njɨmbla yandɨ maa ndɨ kat vɨga la nɨmba kwagalandi maa ndɨ avla vɨga lɨgiyandɨ ndɨna nda kat.
Nɨno wungi vat sɨgɨt. Tat mat nyan vla lɨnɨn. Kɨpmana vat nɨn kat vɨga lɨndɨ. Nɨna maawut yigumba ana yelavɨka lɨnɨn.
God waa nandinya yandɨ maa God ndɨna nyan nɨn kat kwindɨ. Kɨpmana taagwa ndi kat kwutɨ maa lɨndɨ. Yalaa Juda yeta vapmba yetɨndɨ.
Juda yeta vak nat nɨma sakwat nɨmba kat ngilaa lɨndɨ. Wungi vak kat njalapmat yandɨ. Godna nɨmba tɨnangat yandɨ.
Ngwuk Godna nɨmba tɨngwangat ngwuk kat sɨmagavat God ndɨna waagan kwindɨ. Godna waagan nɨna maawupmba lɨga walɨgandɨ. God ngwula nyaekna waa nɨn kat walɨgandɨ.
Mbambala ngwut kwo nɨmba ana ngwuk. Tamba Godna nyangu ngwuk. Ngwuk Godna nyangu kat kwindeya kwanda kwanda klalaa vɨga lɨgiyangwuk.
GALESIAMBA LA NƗMBA KAT POL NƗMA VAT YELAVƗKA LƗNDƗ
Tamba ngwuk Godna mɨndama vɨga ndɨna sɨ ana wuka lɨngwuk. Kɨpmana vapmba yetɨngwuk.

Mbambala Godna mɨndama vɨga ndɨna sɨ wuka lɨgangwuk. God ngwuk kat vɨga lɨgandɨ. Ngwuk manda kat wan vak kwagalalaa kɨpmana vapmba nat njamba yetɨvak walɨgangwuk. Manda kat wan vak kwagalalaa kɨpmana sɨvu njambiyana vapmba kwutaa yetɨvak walɨgangwuk.
Ngwuk nandinyana njambiya mbakna njambiya ndimwena njambiyana vapmba yetɨlɨgangwuk.
Wan kavle vak yingwa vak kat vɨlaa nɨma vak yelavɨka tɨgowun. Gwutnogwinala lɨga ngambuwa vat kwo vatnat anagandɨ ya.

Ngwuk kɨta mbaapma nɨmba Judana njambiya kat yelavɨkwa vat ngwutno yelavɨk ngwula. Wan njambiya kat ana yelavɨka lɨgowun. Ngwulo tak ana yelavɨka lɨngwuk. Tat ngwuk kat mbukwa njɨmbla wun kat ana kai wangwuk. Manda kat mbambala kai walɨgangwuk.
Tak ngwula ngepma yiga tuwa njɨmbla wun kat yelogwen kwutndɨ, tɨwun. Tɨga lɨga ngwuk kat wan apma nyaangɨt mbukwun.

Ngwuk kat yelavɨka lɨgowun. Wuna mbangɨ vɨvak kat kai walɨngwuk. Wuna yelogwen wuna mbangɨ kavle savle lɨndɨ. Ngwuk wun kat ana kai wangwuk. Wun kat yingwa vak ensel kɨta kat yingwa vak vla yingwuk. Wun kat yingwa vak Jisas Kraist kat yingwa vak vla yingwuk.

Ngwuk wun kat solat sɨlɨngwuk. Mbambala manda kat mandɨt maawut yelavɨtɨgangwuk. Tak ngwuk wuna yelogwen kat kwunapmak kat tɨngwuk. Ngwuk ngwutna mɨni pɨngwuga klalaa wuna lak kwivak kat tɨngwuk wuna yelogwen kwunapmak. Mbambala manda kat mandɨt maawut yelavɨtɨgangwuk.
Ngwuk kat savagu la nyaangɨtna mbukwa. Ngwuk wun kat kimbuk yiga lɨgangwuk?
Wuna kwupmba ya nɨmba ngwuk kat nɨmba njɨvwa kwutɨndi. Apma mnaawut yelavɨka ana kwutɨndi. Kɨmbɨk kwutaa vak kalɨpmat tɨlɨndi. Wun kat kai walaa ndina vapmba wukwangat tɨlɨndi.

Ngwuk kat apma vat yivat njɨvwa kwutnja vat apma vatna. Woviyaguga lɨgowun. Mbambala wunngwulogwinala ana lɨgowun. Nat nɨmba ngwuk kat kwunapmat yanjan apma vatna. Woviyaguga lɨgowun. Wan nɨmba ngwuk kat yaa nɨmba ngwuk kat kavle vat yivat yandi.

Ngwuk wuna nyangu vla lɨgangwuk. Wun nyan tɨga taagwa kangɨt waa lɨga vla wupma lɨgowun ngwuk kat. Kraist yeta vak ngwula maawupmba lɨndeyan kangɨt yila vak vla ngɨlɨgiyandɨ. Wunai kwukna nɨmba vla lɨgiyangwuk.
Ngwuk kat miwa yiga lɨgowun. Ngwutnai lɨga ngepmat yivat tɨgowun. Ngwutna mɨndama vɨga wan nyaangɨt mbupmak kat wowun. Pasmba pɨlɨwukweya ana nglaatndɨ. Ngwuk kat nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨgowun.
HEGAOGWI SERANA WAPUSEPUT
Ngwuk Judana lomba yetɨvak walɨgangwuk. Ngwuk kat kɨtga nda kat wagalavat yigowun. Lona vak kat yelavɨka yetɨgangwuk? E? Ana yelavɨtɨgiyangwuk? Lona vak kat ngwuk kat mbupmat yigowun.
Tamba Ebrahamna nyaangɨt pɨlɨwutndi. Ebraham taagwa vɨlɨlɨk klalɨndɨ. Nat taagwa ndɨna taagwat. Nst taagwa ndɨna ngayna njɨvwa kwuta taagwat. Wumbɨt taagwa nyan kɨta kɨta kwupmbɨk.
Ndɨna ngayna njɨvwa kwuta taagwakat Ebraham nyan taagandɨ maa kwutɨ. nat taagwa God waa nyaangɨpmba Ebraham nyan taagandɨ, kwutɨ.

God ndinyangu kat kwiya vɨlɨlɨk ndana aveyambɨ vla lɨga taagwa mbɨt. Nat taagwana sɨ Hega. God Moses kat lo kwiya njɨmbla Moses Sainai walɨnja nduwimba wokelaa klandɨ. Sainai walɨnja nduwi Hega walɨnja taagwana kɨpma. Hegagwi lɨla nyanondi kat nat nɨmba vɨga lɨndi. Ndina maawupmba ana yetɨndi. Wan lo klala nɨmbana angwa ngepma Jerusalema. Ndi Juda ndi. Wundi Juda ndi lona njɨvwa kwutɨga nɨmba ndi. Nat nɨmba Hegana nyangu kat vɨga lɨnja vak vla lo Juda kat vɨga lɨndɨ. Ndi ndina maawupmba ana yetɨndi.
Nɨn Jisasna mbaapma nɨmba nɨn. Jerusalem nɨna angwa ngepma ana ndɨ. nɨna angwa ngepma nyɨnangwupmba lɨgandɨ. Lona njɨvwa kwutɨga nɨmba ana nɨn. Lo nɨn kat ana kwutaa vɨga lɨgandɨ.

Tamba Aisaia God waa nyaangɨt pɨlɨwutndɨ. Nyɨn taagwa nyɨn nyan kwutapman tɨnya vak kat nyɨn ke kɨlɨmalɨ yelavɨka laga. Nyan kwutapman tɨga nyɨn solat sɨga yetɨ. Ngɨni nyangu nɨma sakwat kwukiyanyɨn. Nyan kwutɨga taagwa kat kwulakka nyan kwukiyanyɨn waa wandɨ God waa tamba Aisaia pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Wan God waa nyaangɨt Sera kat yandɨ maa Aisak kat kwutɨ. nɨno Godna mbaapma nɨmba Godna nyangu nɨn. God wandɨ maa ndɨna nyangu vla lɨgangwuk. Aisak ta vla lɨga nɨn.

Hegana nyan ndɨ kwo yandɨ. Ebrahamo Hego mbɨlai kwuta njsvwamba yandɨ. Serana nyan God waa nyaangɨpmba yandɨ. Hegana nyan Serana nyan kat walea lɨndɨ. Wan vak vata tɨvwaligandɨ wan walea lɨmba vat. Nat nɨmba ndi Judana vapmba yetɨnangat walɨgandi. Ngi kat tɨga nɨn kat walea lɨgandi. Nɨn Godna waagan waa nyaangɨpmba yetɨga nɨmba nɨn.

Tamba God Ebraham kat wanda nyaangɨt ndɨ Moses pɨlɨwutndɨ. Mɨna ngayna njɨvwa kwuta taagwa lɨla nyano mɨna ngaykat kai wamɨn yigambɨt. Wan nyan mɨna kwanda kwanda nda ana klaigandɨ. Nat nyan Sera kwukna nyan ndɨ mɨna kwanda kwanda nda aywaa klaigandɨ waa wandɨ God Ebraham kat waa tamba pɨlɨwutndɨ Moses.
Wuna kɨta mbaapma nɨmba, nɨn Hegana nyangu vla ana lɨganɨn. Juda yetɨlɨga lo nɨn kat ana kwutaa vɨga lɨgandɨ. Serana nyangu vla lɨganɨn.
